description: Agent Migration: submit the switch-over plan for one move: optionally when the cutover starts and ends, the expected downtime and whether both systems run during the switch; each phase of the switch (such as freeze, copy, switch or settle) with when it starts and ends and which system is authoritative in it (the source, the target, both or neither); and each kind of work in flight (payments, jobs, messages, webhooks, orders or other) with how it is handled (drained before the switch, replayed after, forwarded, paused, dropped, or no plan) and who owns it. The signed report gives every phase with its authority, every kind of work in flight with its handling, and names a cutover that is unsafe: a phase where both systems are authoritative or two overlapping phases with different authorities, a phase or a gap between phases where neither is, and work in flight that is dropped or given no plan; then payments, jobs or messages the plan never mentions and handling with no named owner, with the fix for each. Halting a running agent system is wever_kill-switch-check, the general rollback path for an action’s effects is wever_rollback-path-check and a single handover of work between parties is wever_handover-check. Verdict cutover_unsafe, cutover_gaps, cutover_unverified or cutover_single_authority. POST /api/migration-cutover-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write, and no data is moved. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-migration-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-migration/.
